== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of Lone Rogue with a bronze errata disc, as served in the starwarsccg.org card lists ([https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/EmpireStrikesBackIntroductoryTwoPlayerGame-Light/large/lonerogue.gif lonerogue.gif]). Uploaded unchanged from the earliest archived copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818004057/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/EmpireStrikesBackIntroductoryTwoPlayerGame-Light/large/lonerogue.gif Internet Archive] (18 August 2019). SHA-1 4116f7856170c3f484bfbac94d2f93a60bfaae17. Shown on [[Lone Rogue (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]].
